description: Hand-fixed, fully synthetic golden baseline for the quota engine facade (buildProfileQuotaSnapshot). All timestamps, profile ids, providers, sample ids, segments, price snapshot ids and scopes are fictional. Inputs and expected outputs are literal values; the test never regenerates expected from the engine at runtime. Migration note: copy this file together with src/shared/quotaEngine/ when rehearsing a move to a clean upstream; if the engine intentionally changes behaviour, update this fixture by hand and record why.

scenarios.codex-weekly-current-partial-cycle: Codex Weekly, current partial cycle, stable linear regression, complete pricing coverage.
scenarios.codex-session-and-weekly-kept-separate: Codex Session and Weekly windows coexist on one profile and never mix; weekly opens mid-cycle (baseline gap), session is a two-point preliminary fit.
scenarios.codex-weekly-full-cycle: Codex Weekly, directly observed full cycle from 1% to 99%.
scenarios.codex-successor-reset-and-jitter-boundar: Successor reset isolates the previous full cycle (capacity borrowed as compatible history), and a sample whose resetsAt sits inside the 2-minute reset jitter still counts as the live cycle.
scenarios.codex-partial-pricing-coverage: Half the observed tokens are unpriced; capacity is still derived but confidence fails to unstable.
scenarios.codex-unknown-model-fails-closed: An unknown model keeps every token unpriced: the API-equivalent metric fails closed (null amounts, unavailable basis).
scenarios.codex-snapshot-migration: A new pricing snapshot id splits the priced run; the current identity has one point and the historical run stays available as an explicit fallback.
